decisions.reason: Separate calendar management is already represented by the operational-isolation Requirement and does not change the candidate's Wix Bookings platform requirement.
Per-location calendar and operational separation does not change the master site's location presentation, routing, or navigation behavior.
The decision to maintain separate calendars per location does not alter the reusable template structure or future-location onboarding behavior.
Operational separation between locations does not change the shared Smash Room brand name or its visual application.
The per-location calendar decision does not change the master site's design reference or layout characteristics.
